description: Introduces a domain era megacorp from the Eridanus sector with its own plans for dealing with the sector. The faction revolves around mysterious technological marvels called resurgence crystals, which are bio-mechanical in nature. This is an early beta version with many features still in development or missing.

discordPostHtml:
Mod By Kwin, Fufufox and Huang(Blaze)
Translated by Mycophobia and also thanks alot for Mrmaglor for all help and initial translations!

Require Boxutil, Lazylib, GraphicsLib, and Magiclib

0.97 Ver - (likely a bit more stable)
https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Farsight-Drive/releases/download/v.0.23/FarsightDrive.-0.97.zip

0.98 Ver
https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Farsight-Drive/releases/download/v.0.23/FarsightDrive.-0.98.zip

A domain era megacorp arriving from the Eridanus sectorwith their own plans to dealing with the sector.

Adding a new faction circled around mysterious technological marvel known as the resurgence crystal bio-mechanical tech

This is a very early beta testing version, with many content being wip or missing and there maybe some bugs, any feedback to the authors are appreciated.

Known Issues: Devourer Cannon extra damage does not work.
Missing Nex Start options (can still use custom start)
